notes.title: Demo Patch 10690
notes.content:
The Morbid Metal Demo has been updated to the latest version 10690

Patch Notes
fixed dark/ unreadable UI when HDR was enabled in Windows settings

added settings to invert camera in X and/or Y-Axis

fixed player getting stuck outside combat area in one combat scenario

other minor bug fixes



Please report any further issues you may encounter. We are determined to deliver a gameplay experience that is as smooth as possible!

notes.title: Morbid Metal is launching into Early Access this summer!
notes.content:
Exciting News!

Hey everyone, we’ve got something exciting to share! Our new trailer for Morbid Metal just dropped during the Triple-I Initiative showcase, and we’re beyond hyped that the game is officially set to launch into Early Access this summer exclusively on Steam.

[previewyoutube=UKiW3UmlcG8;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been many years since the development of Morbid Metal started and I posted the first bits and pieces online. Now we are a small team of passionate developers working on it and we are so proud to finally be able to say it is coming this summer! 

All of you have been eagerly waiting to finally get your hands on Morbid Metal to unleash your stylish combos onto deadly enemies. Your continued support means so much to us and the project would not have been possible without it. Thank you!

We'll have more news coming in the time leading up to the launch, so be sure to follow us here on Steam and our socials so you do not miss anythiung!

Love you guys,
Felix

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/

notes.title: We're Up for the Unity Award - Help Us Bring It Home!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's Felix here, Game Director and founder of Screen Juice. And I have some super exciting news to share with you today!

We've just been nominated for the Unity Awards 2024 in the "Most Anticipated" category!
VOTE NOW AT unity.com/de/awards


I can't tell you how surreal it feels to see our game get this kind of recognition after all the hard work the team and I have been putting in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41770758/60f727585e6e3ba3a8829db5499cbe33dfe93986.png
The nomination came as part of Unite 2024 in Barcelona, which was an absolute blast. Being surrounded by so many talented developers and creative minds was beyond motivating, but seeing our project running for such a prestigious award? That was the cherry on top!

Now, this is where you  come in - voting is live, and we would absolutely love your support. 
If you've been following our journey or if you're excited to see Morbid Metal come to life, it would mean the world to us if you could take a moment to vote for us in the "Most Anticipated" category. Every vote counts, and with your help, we can make it all the way!

Here's how to vote:

[olist]
 Head over to the official Unity Awards 2024 page at unity.com/de/awards
 Choose your favorites for each category, and in the "Most Anticipated" category, look for Morbid Metal!
 Cast your vote and help bring us one step closer to that shiny award!
[/olist]
As always, your support and enthusiasm keep us going, and this nomination has really fired us up to push the game even further. We can't wait to show you more of what we've been working on. There are some exciting updates coming soon, so keep an eye out!

Thank you for sticking with us on this wild ride. Youre support means so much to us, and together, let's make this happen!

Also dont forget to join the Morbid Metal Discord!

Stay awesome,  
Felix & the Morbid Metal Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/

notes.title: Morbid Metal Steam Page Update and New Trailer - Games Made in Germany 2024
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Felix here, Game Director and founder of Screen Juice, formerly the solo developer of Morbid Metal. I hope you're all doing great!

I'm thrilled to announce that our Steam page for Morbid Metal has just been updated with some brand-new images and an exciting new trailer. This update comes just in time for the Games Made in Germany Steam Event 2024, and yes, Morbid Metal is part of it!

[previewyoutube=otg4GQXRL08;full]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=otg4GQXRL08[/previewyoutube]

We've been working tirelessly to bring you an intense, action-packed experience, and these updates will give you a fresh look at what we've been cooking up. The new trailer is something I'm particularly excited about – it captures the heart-pounding, metallic mayhem that Morbid Metal is all about.

Also, stay tuned for 14 brand-new minutes of gameplay coming your way in the next few days! It'll be streamed on the Games Germany Sale stream, as well as right here on Morbid Metal's Steam page.

Thank you all for your continued support and enthusiasm. It means the world to me and the entire team at Screen Juice. Since it's been a while since we last showed new footage, we'd really love to know what you think about all the hard work we've put into the project over the past year!

Check out the new images and trailer, and let us know what you think!

Stay metal,
Felix

notes.title: Big News: Introducing Screen Juice and the Exciting Future of Morbid Metal!
notes.content:
Hey there, Morbid Metal fans!

Felix here, and I'm absolutely raring to share some fantastic news with you all! 

First of all, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for your constant support and unyielding passion towards Morbid Metal. It's been a while since my last update, but I assure you, this radio silence is for good reason! Get ready, because I have some news that will take Morbid Metal to unprecedented heights!

I am proud to announce that I have recently founded SCREEN JUICE, an indie studio focused on making my dream project, Morbid Metal, even larger and better than ever before! Over the past year, I've been working diligently in the shadows to build a talented team that is as passionate about this game as I am. Our team may be small, but it's packed with amazing individuals who are focused on bringing you the best possible experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41770758/1a8f437a13009e380292f5c205eaabf39f661753.png
So, what does this mean for the development of Morbid Metal you ask? 

It means that I now have the funding, the resources, and the crew to expand the scope of the project beyond what I initially envisioned. The development process is no longer that of a lone wolf, but of a collective force of creative minds that want to exceed even your wildest expectations!

I know the silence might have been disconcerting, but trust me, it was all to ensure a smoother and more focused development process. I wanted to be absolutely certain of this major step before making any announcements. Together with my team at SCREEN JUICE I am now hard at work and we are refining every aspect of Morbid Metal, breathing new life into its world, systems and characters!

It's time to break the habit of being tight-lipped and reignite the communication that you deserve. Prepare yourselves for more in-depth looks at the story, characters, and gameplay systems that make up the world of Morbid Metal!

As always, I am immensely grateful for your support during this journey. Please stay tuned for further updates, first-looks, and other cool tidbits that I can't wait to share. The future of MORBID METAL is brighter than ever!

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for believing in the vision of Morbid Metal and for joining us at SCREEN JUICE on our wild ride towards delivering an unforgettable game!

Stay metal!

- Felix
 Founder of SCREEN JUICE & Game Director/ Lead Developer of Morbid Metal

notes.title: Morbid Metal Dev Stream and Gameplay Showcase
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41770758/d7208d8e9531e1ad607f979b860374a74639bd15.png

Games Germany Steam Feature

From February 14th until February 17th, Games Germany is running a Steam Feature and Sale, highlighting games made in Germany.

Morbid Metal is one of the games being featured during this event and for this occasion, I am showcasing new, extended gameplay footage, as well as a short developer stream, talking about the project, how it works, what is planned and where I want to take it.

Tune in on Monday Feb. 17th starting 5PM CET!

I am premiering new and exclusive gameplay footage of Morbid Metal.
Watch an action packed developer stream, showcasing stylish, shapeshifting combat, many engaging enemy encounters, as well as a brutal Boss Fight to top it all off!

I'd love to hear your opinion 
Join the Morbid Metal Discord and talk with me and other about the project!


Want to see more about Morbid Metal?

Check out my Twitter for more frequent updates!
Morbid Metal on Youtube
